    EgradxSignInProviderFactory
    Makes providers of one EgradxSignInProviderFactory.type() from configuration: egradx.auth.oidc.providers.<id>.type: <type>.

    The sign-in providers in use: those configured under egradx.auth.oidc.providers, each made by the EgradxSignInProviderFactory of its type, and those an application registers as EgradxSignInProvider beans.
